name: Add a Worksheet Tablerow
description: Adds rows to the end of specific table. [See the documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/tablerowcollection-add?view=graph-rest-1.0&tabs=http)

configurable_props.name: folderId
configurable_props.label: Folder ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the folder where the item is located

configurable_props.name: sheetId
configurable_props.label: Sheet ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the spreadsheet you want to use

configurable_props.name: tableId
configurable_props.label: Table ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the table you want to use

configurable_props.name: tableName
configurable_props.label: Table Name
configurable_props.description: This is set in the **Table Design** tab of the ribbon.

configurable_props.name: values
configurable_props.label: Values
configurable_props.description: A 2-dimensional array of unformatted values of the table row. [See the documentation to get the data format](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/tablerowcollection-add?view=graph-rest-1.0&tabs=http).
